test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six friends M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting in a row facing north. Only O is seated between P and M. Only R is seated between N and Q. M is not seated at either of the ends and not an immediate neighbour of Q. P is sitting at immediate left of O. Where is N seated?

options.text: At one of the extreme ends

solution:
Let's make the arrangement using the information given,

1) Only O is seated between P and M.

2) P is seating at immediate left of O.

3) M is not seated at either of the ends.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/793d3fa7fa36bf8902288a652d81c4498c6c506ed45a0c698355881e9e756992.png] 

4) Only R is seated between N and Q.

5) M is not an immediate neighbour of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf3ecf6857e53dd025fa32f78a5b9db5dd810bfb73ef75e922d02440367a0305.png] 

Here, we can see that N is seating to the immediate right of M.

Hence, the correct answer is **" Immediate right of M "**.
